hooks.command: cmd="$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""')"; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(]|&&|\|\|)[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+(stash|commit|checkout|switch)([[:space:]]|$)' && [ -n "$(podman ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=docker-torrent-box-with-vpn --format '{{.Names}}' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Stack containers are running. git stash/commit/checkout/switch rewrite the working tree, and a pre-commit stash cycle corrupted live SQLite databases on 2026-07-07. Run make stop_all first."}}'; fi; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Checking the stack is stopped before touching the working tree
